candidates.title: Ext and projectivity: wrong long exact sequence applied to the wrong variable
candidates.quote: \ref{ha:ext-long-exact.1} を $0\to K\to P\to a\to0$ と第一変数 $a$ に適用すると、$\mathrm{Hom}(a,P)\xrightarrow{e_{*}}\mathrm{Hom}(a,a)\to\mathrm{Ext}^{1}(a,K)=0$ が完全。
candidates.problem: The sequence $0\to K\to P\xrightarrow{e}a\to0$ is a short exact sequence in the FIRST variable ($a'=K$, $a=P$, $a''=a$). The relevant long exact sequence is \ref{ha:ext-long-exact.2} (first-variable sequence), which gives $\cdots\to\mathrm{Hom}(a,P)\xrightarrow{e_{*}}\mathrm{Hom}(a,a)\to\mathrm{Ext}^{1}(a,K)\to\cdots$. Item 1 of \ref{ha:ext-long-exact} is the SECOND-variable sequence (short exact in $b$), which does not apply to a short exact sequence ending in $a$. The text explicitly says 「第一変数 $a$ に適用」 while citing item 1, which is the wrong item; the correct citation is \ref{ha:ext-long-exact.2}.
candidates.defense: The displayed conclusion $\mathrm{Hom}(a,P)\to\mathrm{Hom}(a,a)\to\mathrm{Ext}^{1}(a,K)=0$ is exactly what item 2 gives, so the mathematics is right; only the label is wrong. But the label is a citation whose quoted text (item 1) is about a short exact sequence $0\to b'\to b\to b''\to0$ in the second variable, which does not give this sequence. Since the page's own item 2 is the correct statement, this is a mis-citation that a reader following the reference would find does not apply.
candidates.proposed_fix: Replace \ref{ha:ext-long-exact.1} with \ref{ha:ext-long-exact.2} (the first-variable long exact sequence).

second_opinion.reason: The proof applies the long exact sequence to the short exact sequence 0→K→P→a→0 in the first variable, which is exactly the setting of item 2 of \ref{ha:ext-long-exact} (short exact 0→a'→a→a''→0 with a'=K, a=P, a''=a, b=a), giving Hom(a,P)→Hom(a,a)→Ext¹(a,K). Item 1 is the second-variable sequence (short exact in b) and does not apply here. The text explicitly says 「第一変数 $a$ に適用」 while citing \ref{ha:ext-long-exact.1}, so the citation is wrong; it should be \ref{ha:ext-long-exact.2}. The mathematics of the displayed sequence is correct, but the cited item does not give it.

summary: The page is largely correct: the definition of Ext, the basic properties, the two long exact sequences, the Z-computations, the group-cohomology identification, and the Tor/extension remarks all check out. The only concrete defect is in the proof of \ref{ha:ext-projective}: it applies the second-variable long exact sequence (item 1) to a short exact sequence in the first variable, whereas the correct citation is item 2. The displayed conclusion is correct, so this is a mis-citation rather than a mathematical error, but it should be fixed.
